Why doesn't Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir use Google Earth in his UPSC Geography classes? The answer lies in the difference between simply looking at a map and actively learning to read it.

In this clip, Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir, Geography faculty at LevelUp IAS, explains why students should locate and mark places themselves using an atlas instead of relying only on digital maps. The atlas becomes a workbook, helping aspirants engage actively with maps and geographical locations.

His approach also includes discussing 10–15 geographical entries every day, including places relevant to current affairs, to connect map-based learning with UPSC preparation.

Preparing for UPSC CSE 2028? Build your Geography fundamentals, develop map-reading skills, and learn to connect static Geography with current affairs.

#UPSCGeography #AkhileshShrivastava #UPSC2028 #GSFoundation2028 #AtlasForUPSC #UPSCPreparation #CurrentAffairs #LevelUpIAS
